newsitem.title: UK: Unilever shares gain after ADR strength.
newsitem.headline: Unilever shares gain after ADR strength.

text.p: Shares in Unilever Plc rose to a record high for a third day on Tuesday, echoing strong gains in its ADRs in New York yesterday with one major U.S. investment bank said to have been a big buyer of the stock.
Dealers said Monday's giant spirits merger between Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc continued to inspire interest in other possible bid and merger players.

Extending gains following last week's $8 billion sale of its speciality chemicals arm, the stock was up 24-1/2p or 1.4 percent at 17.25-1/2 stg by 0903 GMT in volume of just over one million shares. In the U.S., its ADRs rose $3-1/8 to $112-1/4.
"There is just a lot of interest in anyone that could be involved in corporate activity," said one market-maker in Unilever shares.
Cadbury Schweppes Plc, seen by some as a possible bid target for Unilever or another predator, was up 15-1/2p at 567-1/2.
